items.notes: Feature on the Office of Undergraduate Research's Emerging Scholars Program, with sophomore Valentina Parra's experience.

items.notes: Senior thesis. Faculty adviser (printed "Dr. Sylvia Perry") named on the opening page. items.title: Impacts of Chemistry Beyond the Lab: Green Chemistry with Dr. Mark Aparece
items.notes: Q&A interview with Dr. Mark Aparece, Assistant Professor of Instruction in Chemistry, on green chemistry research and teaching.

items.notes: Profile of Dr. Sarah Rodriguez, professor of global health and medical historian.

items.notes: Senior thesis. Faculty adviser (printed "Dr. Scott Ogawa") named on the opening page. Appendix Tables 1-9 are extracted cell by cell; Figures 1-4B (printed pages 62-65) are plots of merit aid and savings by state with no transcribable text beyond their captions.

items.title: Comprehension and Misinformation: An Interview with Dr. David N. Rapp
items.notes: Q&A interview with Dr. David N. Rapp, Walter Dill Scott Professor of Education in Psychology and the School of Education and Social Policy.

items.title: The Protect of Total War and the Minnesota Starvation Experiment, 1944-1945
items.notes: Senior thesis. The opening page prints the title as "The Protect of Total War..."; the contents page and the contributors page print "The Project of Total War...". Faculty adviser (printed "Dr. Ken Alder") named on the opening page. Appendices reproduce Wallace Kirkland's Life magazine photographs (Figures 1-6) with captions. The bibliography is divided into primary sources, secondary sources, archives and consulted sources.

items.title: From Blades to Breakthroughs: Palmy Lamsam’s Journey from Figure Skating to Research
items.notes: Profile of Thita "Palmy" Lamsam, a former competitive figure skater and Northwestern Marriage and Family Therapy student.

items.title: Early Childhood Shocks in Ghana: Evidence on Physical Health and Cognitive Development
items.notes: Senior thesis. Faculty adviser (printed "Dr. Christopher Udry") named on the opening page. Appendix regression tables are extracted cell by cell. Figures 7-9 (printed pages 112-113) are scanned pages of the rural community survey questionnaire (sections 7A town events, 7B agricultural shocks, 7C crop sales), transcribed from the page images. Text inside the Figure 1 population density map (title and notes; its copyright line is illegible), the WHO disclaimer on the Figure 3 map, and the four stages of the Figure 4 poverty-trap cycle are also transcribed from the images.

items.title: Inside PSYCH 110’s Research Study Requirement
items.notes: First-person feature on the introductory psychology course's research participation requirement.

items.title: Exploring the Intersection of Buddhism and Science: Q&A with Dr. Robin Nusslock
items.notes: Q&A interview with Dr. Robin Nusslock on the Emory-Tibet Science Initiative; the contents page gives the title as "Exploring the Intersection of Buddhism and Science - Q&A with Dr. Robin Nusslock".

items.title: Grief Unmasked
items.notes: Creative senior thesis: a one-paragraph abstract describing eight masquerade masks ("Shock" through "Acceptance") followed by eight full-page photographs of the masks being worn (printed pages 124-131), with no captions or other text. Faculty adviser named on the opening page.

items.title: Interview With Professor Oya Topçuoğlu on Archaeological Fieldwork
items.notes: Q&A interview with Professor Oya Topçuoğlu (Middle East and North African Languages) on archaeological fieldwork in Turkey.

items.title: The Effect of Copyright Term Extension on Creative Productivity
items.notes: Senior thesis. Faculty adviser named on the opening page. Appendices A-E are event-study plots (only their captions are text); Appendix F regression output is extracted cell by cell. The bibliography's entries are extracted in fragments split across blocks.
